title: Numa Numa no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + the stomach Gatling gun as the peak (Logia, no stages and no awakening)
facts: Appearance: not revealed (plain swirl fruit stands in)
Logia, Swamp-Swamp Fruit: the user becomes and controls a bottomless swamp
Attacks sink into him (he absorbed a cannonball)
He stores weapons, treasure and kidnapped people inside his body
Encases an opponent's head in a ball of swamp to suffocate them
Numa Numa no Gatling Gun: a crank Gatling gun rising out of his swamp gut
Cannot change back if trapped where his real body cannot fit: Franky sealed him in a barrel

plan.fruit: The fruit's appearance **has never been revealed**, so a plain round swirl fruit in swamp green stands in (no face or limbs).
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a fisherman in a yellow raincoat and rain hat, with a beard.
**Caribou:** long wild black hair, a wide toothy grin, dark long coat. Send a reference to match him exactly.
**Franky:** blue pompadour, sunglasses, open red-and-yellow shirt, shorts.
plan.sets: misty bayou, olive rays, lily pond, mangrove roots, marsh stage on stilts, stone sea fort, treasure cave, foggy marsh, wrecked ship deck at sunset, cellar full of barrels, pantry of jars, bubble grove, school hallway with lockers.
